FACT: Ned migrated from iTerm2 to Ghostty. Config at ~/.config/ghostty/config. Theme is Dracula dark on pure black background (#000000), not light. Font is ProFontIIx Nerd Font @ 12. iTerm2 had two profiles: Default (opaque) and Hotkey Window (30% transparency). The plist had confusing light/dark entries — the actual in-use theme is dark/Dracula.
CONTEXT: Relevant when helping with terminal config, dotfiles, or appearance customization.
AFFECTS: Don't suggest light themes or assume light mode for Ned's terminal setup.
